title: 489. Sentence Screen Fitting

examples.explanation: Each row holds one word plus trailing spaces, fitting the sentence once.
Rows pack as a-bcd-e twice with the given width.
Four narrow rows together spell the sentence once.

hints: Join the sentence with single spaces plus a trailing space to form one repeating cycle.
Advance a cursor by cols per row; when it lands mid-word, back up to the word start.
Total fitted sentences equal the cursor position divided by the cycle length.
